Reviewed 31 October 2026. Foundation / N3 primary; L1 / N6 secondary. Public lessons and exercises now available.

Foundation AI literacy focused on model limitations, with L1 context, discernment and memory practice. 13 lessons, one quiz and a completion badge. No prerequisites. Public lessons cover model training, prediction, knowledge, context and instruction following, with exercises on personal work tasks. Companion to AI Fluency; either course may be taken first.
V12 review: N2 19% Weak; N3 76% Partial (prompt-injection core gap); N6 54% Partial. Current results: Coverage sheet.

31 Oct 2026: Foundation (N3), with L1 practice (N6); generic and transferable, not specialist cyber or Claude product training. Published learning estimate 3.5h. Public lessons/exercises inspected; not a completion claim. Prompt injection, bank rules and cyber threats still need other teaching. Exceeds the 2h Foundation course budget. Supersedes the historical V8 audit for this course.

L1 AI-assisted work through Delegation, Description, Discernment and Diligence. 14 lessons, one quiz and a completion badge; published learning estimate 4h. Public lessons include task-allocation exercises, prompt improvement, expert-domain output review and a continuing project with a diligence statement. Generic and transferable, with supporting Foundation concepts.
V12 review: N2 29% Weak; N3 29% Weak; N4 11% Weak; N6 67% Partial. Current results: Coverage sheet.

31 Oct 2026: L1 / N6 primary, Foundation support secondary. The four core N6 outcomes have explicit teaching and practice; the rubric does not require graded labs. Does not complete bank platform/data rules, model/effort choice or memory management. Public lessons reviewed, not a course-completion claim. Supersedes the historical V8 audit for this course.
